title: Garbage In, Reasoning Out? Why Benchmark Scores are Unreliable and What to Do About It
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical validity and reliability of reasoning benchmarks like SocialIQa, ToMi, and FauxPas-EAI. While these benchmarks touch on social norms and behavior, the paper evaluates their structural and semantic flaws rather than assessing or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical systems/beliefs specifically.
